生成された動画：=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

YASUO:
Use the uploaded Yasuo reference image as the primary identity reference.

Young Yasuo, age approximately 22. Preserve the exact facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, sword design, and overall silhouette from the reference.

This scene takes place years earlier, so Yasuo should appear slightly younger, cleaner, healthier, and less worn than his fugitive version while remaining unmistakably the same person.

His clothing should preserve the same overall design language as the reference but appear cleaner and less damaged.

Do not redesign his face, hairstyle, body shape, clothing identity, or sword.

Yasuo voice:
Young adult male baritone, low and slightly rough, subtle natural rasp, confident and energetic but restrained.
Natural live-action delivery.
Do not make the voice theatrical, overly aggressive, or exaggerated.


YONE:
Use the uploaded Yone reference image as the primary identity reference.

Preserve the exact facial identity, long dark hair, red-and-black Ionian clothing, body proportions, sword design, and calm disciplined presence.

Yone must remain visually distinct from Yasuo.

Yone voice:
Deep smooth adult male baritone, calm, disciplined, controlled, speaking slowly with quiet authority.
Natural human delivery.
Never sound angry or theatrical in this scene.


SPARRING PARTNER:
One unnamed adult male Ionian swordsman.
Secondary character only.
Simple training clothing.
Do not make him visually resemble Yasuo, Yone, or Yasumasa.
Do not give him dialogue.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the uploaded Ionian mountain temple image as the primary environment reference.

Preserve the elevated mountain training courtyard, traditional Ionian temple architecture, stone training ground, distant mountains, clouds, waterfalls, and flowering trees.

This is a peaceful memory from years earlier.

Natural daylight.
Soft atmospheric haze.
Gentle wind moving leaves, clothing, and hair.

The environment should feel serene, sacred, spacious, and cinematic.

Do not change the location into a bamboo-only forest.
Do not redesign the training courtyard.
Do not introduce modern objects.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Realistic human anatomy.
Realistic sword interaction.
Natural body mechanics.
Natural cloth and hair physics.
Grounded physical movement.
Feature-film quality.

Maintain the same character identity, costume, hairstyle, sword, lighting direction, environment, and body proportions throughout the full video.

Natural cinematic editing.
Avoid excessive cuts.
Avoid rapid montage.
One dominant camera movement per shot.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No text.
No watermark.
No logo.

Audio:
peaceful mountain ambience,
birds,
gentle wind,
soft movement of leaves,
footsteps on stone,
realistic sword swishes,
realistic metal contact.

No background music.

All spoken dialogue must come only from the correct character.
Natural lip synchronization.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Years earlier, in a peaceful Ionian mountain training courtyard, young Yasuo is already sparring with another swordsman. Yasuo fights with speed, strength, and obvious confidence, using efficient footwork and strong controlled sword movements to overwhelm his opponent. He steadily forces the opponent backward and finally knocks him outside the training area without seriously injuring him. Yasuo stops, lowers his sword, and gives a restrained satisfied smile.

Yone has been standing nearby, quietly observing the entire exchange. Without anger or admiration, he calmly tells Yasuo that he used too much strength again. Yasuo turns toward his older brother and answers with youthful confidence that he still won.

Emotional progression:
energetic confidence → controlled victory → restrained pride → quiet disagreement between brothers.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1

Wide cinematic establishing shot.

Show the Ionian mountain training courtyard from the environment reference.

The camera slowly pushes toward the training area.

Young Yasuo and the sparring partner are already engaged in a realistic sword sparring match in the center of the courtyard.

Yone stands farther to one side, calmly watching.

Do not focus on Yone yet.

No dialogue.

The sparring should immediately feel fast, skilled, and physically believable.

CUT.


Shot 2

Medium-wide lateral tracking shot following Yasuo.

Yasuo presses forward with fast, confident sword movements.

His attacks are driven by footwork, body rotation, balance, and controlled strength.

The opponent blocks and retreats.

Yasuo keeps increasing pressure.

Do not use supernatural wind abilities.

Do not use exaggerated acrobatics.

Do not make Yasuo spin unnecessarily.

Keep the sword choreography clean and readable.

CUT.


Shot 3

Medium action shot.

The opponent attempts one final defense.

Yasuo reacts quickly and performs one decisive, controlled sword maneuver that breaks the opponent's balance.

The opponent is knocked backward beyond the edge of the training area and falls safely.

The opponent remains conscious.

Yasuo does not strike again.

Yasuo immediately regains a relaxed standing posture.

CUT.


Shot 4

Medium close-up on Yasuo.

Yasuo lowers his sword naturally.

His breathing is slightly elevated after the sparring.

A small, restrained, confident smile appears.

He clearly believes he performed well.

The camera performs a subtle slow push-in.

Yone remains visible in the background, still and composed.

Yasuo does not speak yet.

CUT.


Shot 5

Medium close-up on Yone.

Yone looks toward Yasuo with calm older-brother authority.

No anger.
No smile.
No exaggerated reaction.

Yone says naturally:

"You used too much strength again."

His delivery is quiet, controlled, and matter-of-fact, as if this is not the first time he has told Yasuo this.

After speaking, Yone remains still and watches Yasuo.

CUT.


Shot 6

Reverse medium close-up on Yasuo.

Yasuo turns his head toward Yone.

He keeps the sword relaxed at his side.

His expression is confident and slightly amused, not hostile.

Yasuo says naturally:

"But I won."

Hold briefly on Yasuo looking at Yone after the line.

End the video here.

Do not continue Yone's next dialogue.
Do not introduce Yasumasa yet.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Young Yasuo is standing in the training courtyard facing Yone.

Yasuo's sword is lowered and relaxed at his side.

Yasuo has just said:

"But I won."

Yone is standing opposite him, calm and composed.

The sparring partner is now outside the main training area and remains secondary.

Keep the same daylight, environment, wardrobe, hairstyles, sword designs, character positions, and overall camera direction for the next video.


=== MOOD ===

A warm and peaceful memory that quietly reveals Yasuo's defining flaw.

He is talented, confident, and likable, but he still believes victory proves that his choices are correct.

Yone should feel like the calm counterweight to Yasuo's youthful confidence.

The scene should feel beautiful and serene on the surface, while subtly foreshadowing the tragedy to come.、16:9
